text.p: Pemberstone Plc said on Wednesday it had reached agreements for four recommended acquisitions totalling 14.57 million stg.
The company has made offers for the entire share capital of property companies First Predator Plus Plc, Predator Three Plc and Tamworth assets Plc.
Agreement has also been reached to make a recommended offer to acquire Predator Five Plc on May 1.
Shareholders will have the option of receiving Pemberstone shares in respect of each offer.

Pemberstone also announced that it had reached agreement with South Eastern Recovery Assured Homes Plc (SERAH) to make a recommended offer to acquire all the issued share capital not already owned by the company.
Prior to the offer, Pemberstone owned 22.15 percent of SERAH.
The first closing date of the offer for First Predator Plus, Predator Three and Tamworth assets is May 7.
